semiconductor_relevance: High — Oxide specializes in next-generation semiconductor materials, particularly gallium oxide and high-quality single crystals, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Oxide Corporation develops and manufactures innovative semiconductor materials, including gallium oxide and single crystal substrates. Their product offerings also extend to optical components and laser technologies that support a wide range of applications in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Nonlinear optical devices for wavelength conversion
Laser technologies including pulsed and continuous wave lasers

regional_presence.Japan: Oxide Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is focused on growth within the Japanese market.
